verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs explicitly offer embeddings and reranking for search and context retrieval, list embeddings among its 100+ supported model types, recommend embedding models, and state that the REST API serves embedding models. That lets a developer build a retrieval pipeline on the same platform used for generation. Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail for embeddings and reranking (API shape, specific reranker models), more than a single thin mention of reranking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
